mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause acute kidney injury; vancomycin requires dose adjustment based on renal function, and zoledronic acid is contraindicated in severe renal impairment, creating compounded renal risk.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and renal function closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative bisphosphonate or defer zoledronic acid if vancomycin-induced nephrotoxicity occurs; adjust vancomycin dosing based on renal clearance.
